d:
In this video, I travel deep into South Sudan to experience life with the Mundari tribe, one of Africa’s most unique cattle-based communities.
I spent a night in their cattle camp, living among thousands of cows, camping under the open sky, and even trying their daily lifestyle from bathing in the open to understanding how deeply their lives are connected to cattle.
From smoke-filled camps to raw, untouched traditions, this is a side of the world very few people get to see.
A real and unfiltered journey into the life of the Mundari tribe.
